about: Life... Finds a Way shows Dr. Ian Malcolm, Jeff Goldblum's leather-jacketed chaos mathematician from Jurassic Park, pausing mid-sentence with his trademark halting delivery. In the film he warns that nature cannot be controlled: even an all-female dinosaur population will figure out how to breed. The meme applies that solemn line to anything that keeps coming back or slips past every safeguard, from weeds in sidewalk cracks to kids defeating parental controls.
origin: The line is from Steven Spielberg's Jurassic Park (1993), during the lunch scene where Malcolm argues with the park's creators that their breeding controls will fail.
usage:
The default captions split the quote, "life..." on top and "finds a way" below, with the situation in a post title. You can also put the setup in the top box (the thing that should have stopped something) and keep "life finds a way" on the bottom as the verdict.

It shines when something persists against all odds: a cat getting onto the counter, a bug that survives three fixes, a student finding a way around the school firewall, mold in a sealed container. Goldblum's dramatic pause is part of the joke, so use ellipses and keep it slow.
ideas: the bug we fixed in three releases
the cat when I blocked the counter
the plant I forgot to water for a month
